verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Solid can be used as a small, embeddable UI library (Asciinema case study) and is web-component friendly with real DOM elements and custom renderers, suggesting it can be dropped into part of a page or scaled up. However, there is no explicit first-party guidance or documented pattern for incremental adoption (e.g., mounting into existing apps, migration path) — missing for 10: official incremental-adoption docs, evidence of mounting into a subset of an existing non-Solid app, and independent case studies beyond one HN example.
